svg.title: DuoBar combined circular status icon
svg.desc: Design mockup of a battery ring with percentage above, Wi-Fi in the center and four cellular dots below. Examples show fifty percent normal, sixteen percent low battery, eighty percent charging, sixty percent Low Power Mode, and separate connectivity-strength examples. This is not a device screenshot or a validation result.

g.text: Battery ring · Wi-Fi center · cellular dots
